## Current role — Senior Frontend Developer, CreatorsAGI (Feb 2025 – present, remote from Toronto)

AI startup behind HyperLive: white-labeled AI webinars and sales agents that companies run on their own domains.

- Owns the frontend of both user-facing apps (the visitor-facing app and the admin Studio), taking
  features from design through the API and AI services they depend on (Next.js, TypeScript, Python).
- Built the AI webinar experience from scratch: an AI presenter narrates a company's slides in real
  time (OpenAI Realtime API), visitors raise a hand to ask questions by voice, with live captions.
- Built chat-based configuration for the AI agent: wrote 10+ MCP tools for Studio's AI assistant
  (Claude Agent SDK, Python), so admins set up booking, branding, analytics and slide cues in plain language.
- Shipped self-serve billing in Studio: Stripe checkout, prepaid credit balance, plan-based feature
  gating and a trial-expired flow that leads users to upgrade.
- Added distributed tracing across Next.js and Python services with Sentry.

## Contract Software Developer — Independent (Apr 2022 – Feb 2025)

- FormKiQ (https://formkiq.com) — TypeScript/React front end for an AWS-partnered document management
  platform handling 50M+ documents. REST API integration and direct-to-S3 uploads via presigned URLs.
- Admin dashboards for mobile game operators: player and revenue analytics, live in-game events
  and in-game currency configuration.
- Royal Path — React Native swipe game shipped to Google Play.
  https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.royalpath.voidverse
- Conscious (https://www.getconscious.online/) — Chrome extension (Firebase, Firestore) shipped to the
  Chrome Web Store; interrupts impulse purchases on Amazon and tracks money saved.
- Owned scoping, delivery and client communication.

## Financial Statement Auditor — Baker Tilly Ukraine (2018 – 2022), KPMG Canada (2022)

Audited financial statements before switching to engineering. Worked daily with sensitive client financial data.

## Skills

Frontend: React, Next.js, TypeScript, JavaScript, Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui, React Native, design systems.
AI / LLM: OpenAI Realtime API, Claude Agent SDK, MCP, Gemini / Vertex AI, LLM tool calling, RAG, prompt engineering.
Backend & data: Node.js, Python (FastAPI), REST APIs, Server-Sent Events, PostgreSQL, Supabase, Firebase, Stripe, WorkOS.
Tooling & practices: Git, Vercel, Sentry, Playwright, CI/CD, feature flags, Core Web Vitals,
end-to-end testing, multi-tenant architecture.
